GET/POST /env/:env/segments/:key go through the existing route table so the Host/Origin guard runs first; the 32 MiB cap is a readForm argument inside the upload handler only, every other route keeps 1 MiB. Failure reasons map to 400 (CSV), 422 (CONFLICT, VERSION_EXISTS), 502 (REQUEST_FAILED); no member is ever rendered. Unplanned but required: Route/HttpError/send/readForm extracted to http-primitives.ts to avoid an import cycle; segment-routes.test.ts (15 cases); the FileReader handler in app.js placed before its early return; segments.css registered in stylesheet.ts; FileReader added to the browser globals in eslint.config.js; publishSegment/readSegmentVersion added to three existing DashboardPorts construction sites (http-server.test.ts, test/main.test.ts, e2e/support/fixtures.ts) because DashboardPorts widened. | VERIFY: gates green on first run, no healer retry; graded 9/9/9/9 against minScores 9/8/9/8, overallPass true; no dimension scored 10 so no 10->9 demotions.

dimensionScores.evidence: matchSegmentRoute is called from the existing match() table in http-server.ts dispatch, which applies 405 then the isSameOrigin POST guard before route.handle, so the body is never read on a bad Origin. segment-routes.test.ts 'refuses an upload without the dashboard origin' asserts 403 and publishSegment not called; the body limit is a readForm argument inside the handler, so it cannot short-circuit routing.

readForm in http-primitives.ts takes limit = MAX_BODY_BYTES (1 MiB) by default; only the upload POST passes MAX_SEGMENT_CSV_BYTES (32 MiB). Tests cover a body just under 32 MiB accepted, a body above it 413 with no publishSegment call, and ~1 MiB+ to /env/production/features/dark returning 413. Global default unchanged.

UPLOAD_STATUS maps EMPTY_FILE/MALFORMED_ROW/HEADER/TOO_MANY_MEMBERS/INVALID_SEGMENT to 400, CONFLICT and VERSION_EXISTS to 422, REQUEST_FAILED to 502. Tests assert 400/422/422/502 and that neither the malformed-row error body nor the success body contains 'bob@x.io'; the success page renders only 'Uploaded as version N.' and rejected uploads assert publishSegment not called.

segment-page.ts emits the hidden expectedCurrentVersion from readSegmentVersion, empty when null; tests assert value=7 and value=empty. parseExpectedVersion returns null for '' explicitly and the test asserts expectedCurrentVersion: null reaches the port; a non-numeric value is 400. app.js has a FileReader submit handler filling the csv field before the watch-version early return, segments.css is in STYLE_FILES in stylesheet.ts, and the key is HTML-escaped. Gap: segments.css being served is inferred from registration, not asserted in this phase's test.
